halt_handoff.text:

backlog still has items I didn't reach.

Progress so far: architecture quality 7→9.5; state management 9→8; domain modeling 9→9.5; data flow 8→9.5; framework idioms 9→9.5; concurrency 9→10; simplicity 7→9.5; test strategy 8→8; credibility 8→8.
Never moved: architecture_quality (7 loops), state_management (7 loops), domain_modeling (7 loops), data_flow (7 loops), framework_idioms (7 loops), concurrency (7 loops), simplicity (7 loops).

Current Priority 1 (carried forward):
  - F-008: G32 accepts non-canonical candidate fingerprints — the recurrence guard trusts unchecked input, so unchanged architecture can vary the field and evade recurrence.

Next step options:
  (a) Bump cap and resume — `$contest-refactor --scope contest-refactor --cap 15` continues from here.
  (b) Accept current state — 10 loops landed substantial improvements; current source is the new baseline.
  (c) Reset — `$contest-refactor --scope contest-refactor --reset`.

findings.title: G32 accepts non-canonical candidate fingerprints
findings.why_it_matters: The recurrence guard must derive candidate identity from the review payload instead of trusting an agent-supplied string.
findings.what_is_wrong: G32 checks only that candidate_fingerprint is non-empty and never recomputes the canonical digest; a positive candidate fixture passes the placeholder fp-sha256-architecture-payload-0001.
findings.leverage_impact: One existing G32 check can protect recurrence identity for candidate and terminal states.
findings.locality_impact: The canonical digest owner exists, but its sole trust-boundary consumer does not call it.
findings.metric_signal: A strict positive G32 fixture passes a human-readable placeholder instead of a computed digest.
findings.why_weakens_submission: An unchanged candidate can vary the unchecked field and evade same-fingerprint recurrence routing, defeating the loop-control invariant.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Reuse candidate_fingerprint(review) inside G32, require exact equality for candidate and terminal states, replace positive-fixture placeholders with computed digests, and add one mismatched-digest negative fixture.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: G32 must recompute the canonical fingerprint it gates.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: Call the existing candidate_fingerprint function from G32.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Do not add another digest algorithm or persisted field.
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: Add one mismatched-digest negative fixture, repair positive digests, then run the full suite.

backlog.title: Recompute canonical candidate fingerprints at G32
backlog.why_it_matters: Recurrence identity must not be agent-controlled unchecked input.
